businesses.business: specialty chemistry and data analytics for energy

offering_description.value: Develops and sells specialty chemistries such as surfactants, solvents and cleaning/ well-treatment additives to oilfield service companies and energy producers. Also provides real-time chemistry and fluid analytics through its data analytics business (ProFrac-related customer concentration). Chemicals are manufactured and blended in Texas and delivered to customers.

primary_products.value: specialty oilfield chemicals; surfactants; solvents and terpene-based additives; industrial cleaning and consumer-ingredient chemistries; chemistry analyzers

primary_services.value: real-time fluid analytics; chemistry monitoring and optimization; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: oilfield service companies, oil and gas producers, industrial and consumer product manufacturers

end_markets.value: oil and gas; industrial cleaning; consumer products

revenue_model.value: product sales: specialty chemicals sold to oilfield service and energy customers; subscription: data analytics and monitoring equipment and software; service fees: analytics and chemistry monitoring services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: blends specialty chemicals from purchased raw materials, sold to oilfield service companies and producers; service provider: provides real-time fluid analytics to energy operators

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US onshore oil and gas basins, plus Middle East and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: specialty chemicals and data analytics, both serving energy customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to oilfield service companies and producers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical manufacturing and handling under EPA, TSCA, OSHA and oilfield chemical disclosure rules

notes: Segment mix and recent details may have changed; customer concentration and subscription model for analytics are uncertain.
